translation:
Treats external barriers and similar syndromes.

Soft Qianhu (1 qian), white Jiegeng (8 fen), straight Fangfeng (1 qian), Chuan Duhuo (3 fen), Jing Shaoyao (1 qian), fat Zhimu (5 fen, stir-fried)

Cut into slices, decoct in water, and take hot.

If one has been heavily affected by wind-cold, add Qianghuo (5 fen), small Chuanxiong (2 fen), and Baizhi tip (2 fen) to the first two doses; remove them when taking the later doses.

If there is much tearing, add Bei Xixin (2 fen) and garden chrysanthemum (5 fen).

If there is swelling, add Tinglizi (3 fen).

If the pain is severe, add thick Huangbai (3 fen).

If the redness is severe, add Lianqiao (3 fen), Sangbaipi (4 fen), Mudanpi (6 fen), and Honghua (3 fen).

If there are films, add Muzei (4 fen) and Bai Jili (8 fen).

If there are films, barriers, and fleshy growths, add Shijueming (1 qian, calcined).

If there is dimness and confusion, add Mimeng Hua (8 fen) and garden white chrysanthemum (5 fen).

If the inner canthus is red, add Zhizi kernel (7 fen, stir-fried black).

If the outer canthus is red, add Suanzaoren (1 qian, stir-fried), Yuanzhi flesh (soaked in licorice decoction until soft, bone removed, stir-fried, 1 qian), Maidong (1 qian, core removed), garden white chrysanthemum (3 fen), Shengdihuang (1 qian), Danggui tail (3 fen), and Shudihuang (1 qian).

If it is a newly arisen red eye, taking the medicine for six or seven doses can cure it, and the eye will have no after-effects. (External eye-drop medicine)

If it breaks out repeatedly, wind pathogen and accumulated heat have entered the channels; when it meets cold it immediately breaks out. After taking the Jinye Decoction for more than ten doses, make it either into a powder or into pills and take it, regulating for thirty-four days, and externally apply the Yuhua Elixir once daily, and it will be cured.

If the body is deficient, one must use the Modified Rehmannia Pill, taken on an empty stomach, and after meals use the Jinye Powder; this method is the most excellent.

When taking the Jinye Decoction, one must take it hot after meals, taking only one dose per day, and must not take it suddenly in excess, for fear of injuring the stomach qi. After taking it for six or seven days, it will cure itself.

If the internal heat is severe, with constipation, and the person is robust and young, add Dahuang one or two qian, and remove it after it has opened the bowels. This disease is most common in Beijing; for the decoction use the Five Dragon [Decoction].
translator_notes: Formula and herb names are rendered in standard English Chinese-medicine terms; dosages (qian, fen) are preserved as written.
咀片 (ju pian) means cutting the herbs into slices for decoction.
家園菊/家白菊 (garden chrysanthemum) refers to cultivated chrysanthemum (Ganju).
濃黃柏 (thick Huangbai) means using Huangbai in a strong/thick manner.
